title: Yellow Crisp Kenyan Sweet Rice Flour Chapssalgaru Bowl
description: A fatty and crisp Kenyan dish featuring sweet rice flour chapssalgaru, perfect for midnight cravings, served in a lacquerware bowl. This recipe is dairy-free friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sweet rice flour, salt, sugar, and active dry yeast.
Gradually add in water and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and shiny.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and shape it into small balls.
Fry the dough balls until they are golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fried chapssalgaru on paper towels and serve in a lacquerware bowl.
Drizzle with coconut oil and sprinkle with vanilla extract.
